messages.content: আমি কি খুব বেশি overthink করছি এই text message reply niye?
Honestly probably হ্যাঁ, but eta bola shohoj - ki lekhecho, ki niye confuse hocho?
ekta simple 'ok' peyechi 2 ghonta por, ami bhabchi ami kichu bhul korechi
Actually eta onek somoy shudhu busy howar sign, kichu na - manush der response speed emotion er indicator na always।
tumi thik bolcho hoyto, ami beshi read into korchi
Fair observation actually - eta khub common pattern, ekta 2-word reply theke ekta puro story banano. Try koro next time literal e neya, unless strong evidence thake onno kichu bhabar.
